answer: P&G defines the boundary as purchases of raw and packaging materials, intermediates, storeroom materials, and externally purchased finished products for P&G products sold. The 2030 goal is a 40% reduction per unit of production from a 2020 baseline; reported progress was a 9% reduction across all categories.
